At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.
Salary Range:
$79,800.00 - $170,300.00 The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and implementing microservices following Hexagonal Architecture principles

• Actively contributing to architectural decisions and solution design

•
Spring Boot 3.x / 4.x , MVC & WebFlux

• Gradle

•
PostgreSQL , JPA/Hibernate, R2DBC

• MongoDB

• Apache Kafka, Avro, Confluent Schema Registry

• Hexagonal Architecture, Microservices, Event-Driven Design, Transactional Outbox

• OAuth2 / JWT, Spring Security, OpenFGA

• Spock Framework, Testcontainers, WireMock, REST-Assured, ArchUnit, PIT Mutation Testing

• GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm

• Strong experience with Java 21+ and Spring Boot , including MVC and/or WebFlux

You’ll be working within a highly complex distributed environment consisting of dozens of microservices and numerous communication channels. Understanding the wider system landscape will be just as important as working effectively with individual components.

title: Senior Director, Care Operational Excellence
description:

A day in the life (Responsibilities)
Toast is looking for a Senior Director, Customer Care Operational Excellence to own how our customer support organization operates, end to end. This is a build-and-run role: you will design (and continuously redesign) the people, process, systems, and data that determine whether every customer, from our smallest SMB accounts to our largest Enterprise relationships, gets a fast, effortless, high-quality resolution.
This role sits at the center of our AI transformation of Support operations, evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI across chat, voice, and agent-assist workflows, while also owning the fundamentals: workforce planning and capacity, quality and performance measurement, and a closed-loop voice-of-customer program that feeds directly into our product and engineering roadmaps. You will lead a team, and this is a hands-on role: you're expected to get into the details, run point on hard problems personally, and build things yourself when needed.
Support Operating Model: People, Process & Systems

• Own the end-to-end design of how Support operates: org structure, staffing model, tiering/routing, escalation paths, and channel model (chat, email, phone, self-service, community), and continuously refine it as the business scales.

• Build and run the operating cadence for the function: performance reviews, root-cause/escalation reviews, leadership readouts, and continuous-improvement rhythms.

• Segment design so that SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customers each get a service model appropriate to their needs, complexity, and value.

• AI & Support Technology Transformation

• Own the roadmap for AI-enabled support, including virtual agents/chatbots, voice AI, agent-assist, and automation, from business case through implementation, measured adoption, and iteration.

• Partner with Product and Engineering as a co-owner of the tools and systems Support runs on: helpdesk/CRM, contact center (CCaaS), knowledge base, and AI/automation platforms, representing Support's requirements and stress-testing what's shipped.

• Evaluate, select, and manage the vendor and technology stack (including AI vendors and BPO/outsourcing partners), balancing cost, quality, and customer experience.

Data, Insights & Performance Measurement

• Define the metrics that matter for Toast ’s support operations, including but not limited to TTR/resolution time, CSAT, customer effort (CES), quality/QA scores, cost-to-serve, and AI containment/deflection rate. Partner with Analytics to build the reporting and analytics and associated insights to drive operations across lines of business, segments, channels, and geographies.

• Build a rigorous quality assurance program (QA scoring, calibration, coaching feedback loops) to ensure consistency as the org scales and as AI takes on more of the work.

• Use data to diagnose root causes of poor experience and prioritize the highest-leverage fixes across people, process, and systems.

• Voice of the Customer & Product Feedback

• Own Product Feedback program in partnership with VOC and other related efforts: capturing, synthesizing, and prioritizing feedback and issues surfaced through Support.

• Build the formal, closed-loop mechanism that routes customer and product feedback to R&D/Product leadership, ensuring it gets actioned and tracked through to impact on support volume and CSAT.

• Workforce Planning & Capacity Management

• Own workforce planning, forecasting, and capacity management (staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, real-time management) across in-house and outsourced/BPO teams.

• Model the impact of AI automation on headcount and capacity plans, and adjust staffing levels as containment rates change.

title: Associate Manager, Rehabilitation

Reporting to the Manager, National Rehabilitation, the Associate Manager will lead a team of Functional Rehabilitation Specialists and Vocational Rehabilitation Specialists who develop and deliver individualized, goal-oriented rehabilitation and return-to-work strategies. The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with strong rehabilitation knowledge to coach clinical and vocational decision-making, support complex case consultation, and promote consistent, evidence-informed practices and outcomes.
Responsibilities

Leadership and People Development

• Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing remote team of rehabilitation specialists with functional and vocational expertise.

• Build specialist capability through regular case consultation, quality-focused feedback, knowledge sharing, and targeted development planning.

• Support sound professional judgment, clear documentation, effective communication, and timely decision-making in complex or sensitive situations.

• Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and engaged team culture aligned with Manulife ’s values.

• Identify, develop, and retain talent, and recognize performance and contributions.

Rehabilitation Practice Leadership and Quality

• Provide practice leadership and consultation on complex rehabilitation and disability cases, including functional, workplace, and vocational barriers to recovery and return to work.

• Coach specialists in developing, monitoring, and adjusting individualized, goal-oriented rehabilitation plans that are aligned with functional abilities, job demands, medical information, and sustainable return-to-work or job-resolution goals.

• Guide functional rehabilitation approaches, including assessment of treatment needs, coordination with providers, evaluation of progress, and development of creative return-to-work solutions.

• Guide vocational rehabilitation approaches, including vocational assessment, transferable skills analysis, occupational research, career planning, retraining, job development, and job-search strategies.

• Promote appropriate interpretation and application of rehabilitation industry standards, disability insurance principles, medical terminology, job demands, and regional labour-market information.

• Review rehabilitation strategies and files for quality, clarity, appropriate rationale, measurable goals, cost effectiveness, and alignment with best practices.

• Support specialists in communicating difficult or complex information with professionalism, compassion, and appropriate boundaries.

Operational Excellence

• Oversee workflow, caseload distribution, productivity, and service delivery to meet service standards and client expectations.

• Support effective vendor and budget management by coaching specialists to select appropriate, timely, and cost-effective services and programs.

• Promote consistent documentation, timely follow-up, and effective collaboration across functional and vocational rehabilitation services.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

Getting paid is still one of the most manual parts of running a business. Finance teams chase invoices over email, match payments to invoices by hand in spreadsheets, and close the books late because cash data is scattered across banks, payment processors, and ERPs.

Ramp's Accounts Receivable team is building the system that automates all of it, from the moment an invoice is sent to the moment cash is reconciled in the general ledger. We own the full receivables lifecycle: invoicing, collections, payments, cash application, and accounting sync.

We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own core pieces of that system. The work sits where hard engineering problems meet real money: matching messy payment data to the right invoices, keeping ledgers correct to the cent, and syncing reliably with the accounting systems our customers depend on. You'll own projects end to end, from design through production, and work closely with product and design to turn complex finance workflows into software that just works.

title: Director, FP&A
description:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. title: Manager/Lead, Deal Desk
description:
MANAGER / LEAD, DEAL DESK

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our first Deal Desk hire, you will build and run the function from the ground up.

You will report into the Revenue Operations function and partner with Sales, Finance and Legal to structure complex deals, accelerate approvals, improve pricing discipline and make it easier for customers to buy from Antithesis.

This is a high-trust, highly autonomous role. We are looking for someone who can manage competing priorities, operate with incomplete information and drive issues to resolution without waiting for direction.

A core responsibility is protecting the long-term economics of the business. You will help us close strong deals without creating pricing precedent or commercial terms that unnecessarily erode future contract value or margin.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own Deal Desk day to day, including deal structuring, reviews, approvals and escalations.

- Partner with Account Executives on usage commitments, ramps, multi-year terms, payment terms, renewals, expansions and co-term structures.

- Model ACV, TCV, discounting, usage economics and margin and recommend commercially sound structures.

- Protect long-term contract value and margin by evaluating the downstream impact of pricing, discounts and non-standard terms.

- Identify pricing inconsistencies, approval bottlenecks, process gaps and recurring deal friction.

- Leverage AI to be a force multiplier - find efficiencies and strategic gains in the process.

- Own and optimize DealHub workflows, approvals, quote templates and CRM integration.

- Build and enforce pricing guides, playbooks and guardrails that enable reps to self-serve standard deals.

- Track deal cycle time, approval turnaround, discounting, exceptions and SLA performance and use those insights to improve the process.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

FIRST 30 DAYS

- Learn our product, pricing and sales motion.

- Map the quote-to-cash process and identify major friction points.

- Begin independently supporting live deals.

FIRST 90 DAYS

- Become the primary Deal Desk partner for non-standard deals.

- Establish a clear intake process, approval matrix and SLA framework.

- Publish pricing and deal-structure guidance.

- Improve DealHub workflows and simplify the sales process.

FIRST 12 MONTHS

- Reduce deal cycle time and approval turnaround.

- Improve pricing discipline and deal quality.

- Increase rep self-service on standard deals.

- Build a scalable Deal Desk operating model.

WHAT YOU BRING

- 5+ years in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A or a similar role in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

- Experience structuring complex enterprise deals, including usage-based pricing, multi-year agreements, co-term renewals and non-standard commercial terms.

- Experience with DealHub or another CPQ platform, including approvals, quoting workflows and process optimization.

- Experience with Ironclad or other CLM tools

- Strong financial modeling skills and working knowledge of SaaS metrics and ASC 606.

- Familiarity with enterprise contracting, including payment terms, renewals, co-terming and commercial exceptions.

- Strong commercial judgment. You understand that closing the deal matters, but so do its long-term economics and precedent.

- High trust and ownership. You can handle sensitive pricing and commercial decisions, prioritize independently and know when to escalate.

- High EQ with persistence. You can challenge assumptions, push back when needed and keep work moving without damaging relationships.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You can form a point of view, make recommendations with incomplete information and drive toward resolution.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

- Experience supporting usage-based or infrastructure software businesses.

- Experience building or improving Deal Desk processes in a scaling organization.

- Experience with marketplace transactions, including AWS Marketplace, is a plus.

title: Senior Proposal Specialist

As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the role coordinates all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors with a high degree of independence.
An expert persuasive writer and disciplined project manager, the Senior Proposal Specialist uses the content library and company-approved generative AI tools to produce compliant, win-focused responses efficiently. • Research the customer, incumbent and competition, and inform sales-led bid/no-bid decisions.

• Run the kickoff, build the schedule backward from the due date, define roles and track risks and actions.

• Verify AI output, protect confidential data, champion AI adoption and grow the content library.

Post-Submission Support

• Lead debriefs and lessons-learned sessions and share findings with the team.

• Play a stronger supporting role in clarifications, Q&A, orals, BAFOs, protests, award transition and close-out.

Coaching, Mentoring & Team Development

• Coach and mentor Proposal Specialists and junior staff, modeling best practices as a go-to expert.

• Have new hires shadow live pursuits; shadow junior members and review and edit their work.

• Support onboarding and training for new team members.

Department Initiatives & Process Improvement

• Lead or contribute to initiatives improving processes, templates, checklists, standards and the content library.

• Develop and deliver training; attend industry days, pre-proposal conferences and professional development.

• Analyze lessons learned and win/loss trends, recommend improvements and share best practices.

What We Expect of You:
Minimum basic requirements

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

• Five or more years of proposal writing or proposal management experience, including leading complex responses.

title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.

Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.

You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices.

What You'll Be Doing

•
Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.

•
Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.

•
Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.

•
Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.

•
Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.

•
Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.

•
Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.

•
Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.

•

title: Junior Back-End Software Engineer
description:
As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.
We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.
Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo - Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.
Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment - because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.
We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.
What You'll Do

•
Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code - we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.

•
Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.

•
Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.

•
Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing - especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.

•
Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.

•
Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.

•
Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.

•
Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

Requirements
Who We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is a full-stack generalist, and has experience taking a product from 0-1 product. We're looking for someone who's entrepreneurial and willing to roll up their sleeves to get the work done, and passionate about our mission to build a platform that will intensely disrupt the healthcare industry.
• You have 1+ years of experience

• SST

• Drizzle

• Node

• AWS Services (SQS, EventBridge, Lambda etc..)

• SQL Databases

• Problem solving

• Database Schema Design

• You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects and or large areas of the code base
• Strong experience in building paid products and services is preferred.

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
About Velixo
Velixo builds Excel-native reporting, planning, and automation for finance teams running Acumatica, Sage Intacct, Business Central, and MYOB. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Montreal, we serve finance and accounting teams who live in spreadsheets and need their ERP data to be live, trustworthy, and writable.

Velixo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This is a fully remote position. While we welcome applications from across Canada, we are giving priority to candidates located in Quebec at this time.

The role
You will own how well Velixo Intelligence works and what it costs us to run. That means building the evaluation infrastructure that tells us whether a model change made our product better or worse, and driving down the cost per action without degrading quality.
This is a measurement-first engineering role. Today we ship AI features and form opinions about quality from anecdotes. You will replace that with evidence.
About Velixo Intelligence
Velixo Intelligence is our MCP-based gateway that lets finance teams query their ERP in natural language and perform governed writebacks from Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot. Reads run through GIQL, our query language. Writes go through the ERP's own screen APIs so that every permission, validation, and audit rule still applies.
It launched in public preview this year. Usage is growing, the surface area is expanding, and our understanding of the unit economics has not kept pace. That gap is the reason this role exists.
What you will own
Evaluation

• Build and maintain regression suites for GIQL query generation, writeback correctness, and tool selection

• Define what "good" means for each action type and make it measurable

• Run structured evaluations before every model upgrade or prompt change, and produce a clear ship or no-ship recommendation

• Track quality over time so we notice degradation before customers do

Cost engineering

• Instrument every Gateway action for tokens, cache behavior, model, latency, and tenant

• Establish and maintain the cost-per-action baseline that the rest of the company plans against

• Reduce cost through prompt compression, prompt caching, context pruning, and routing work to smaller models where evaluation shows quality holds

• Identify the expensive tail: which customers, which query shapes, which failure and retry loops

Model strategy

• Track new model releases across providers and evaluate them against our workloads rather than published benchmarks

• Maintain a current view of the price and performance frontier for what we do

• Recommend when to migrate, when to wait, and when to run models in parallel

Partnership with Finance

• Supply the unit cost data behind our credit pricing and plan allowances

• Model the margin impact of proposed pricing changes alongside our VP Finance

• Flag when product decisions will move the cost curve before they ship

You will not own pricing decisions. You will own the numbers those decisions depend on.
First 90 days

• Days 1 to 30: Full instrumentation of the Gateway. A dashboard showing cost per action type, per tenant, and per model that the exec team checks weekly.

• Days 31 to 60: A working evaluation suite covering our highest-volume action types, with a documented baseline.

• Days 61 to 90: A prioritized cost reduction roadmap with sized estimates, and at least one shipped optimization with measured before-and-after quality.

What we are looking for

• Substantial experience building on LLM APIs in production, not in demos or notebooks

• You have built an eval harness before and can explain why the naive version of it misleads you

• Hands-on with the current tooling landscape: tracing and observability platforms such as Langfuse, eval frameworks such as promptfoo. You have opinions about which of these earn their keep and which add ceremony without adding signal.

title: #1023 - Data Security Solution Engineer

description:
Job brief - Opportunity only available for Latam Professionals
We're looking for a hands-on Data Security Solutions Engineer to design and validate database-level security for licensed third-party data: identity-based authentication, fine-grained authorization, auditing, and access revocation/deletion. The role includes running POCs and turning validated patterns into reusable, production-ready designs.
Responsibilities
Technical and Database Assessment

• Review Data In-Licensing requirements, workflow maps, data flows, data lineage, entitlement rules, and dependency records.

• Assess relational database platforms, schemas, connectivity methods, interfaces, drivers, service identities, query patterns, and downstream consumption.

• Identify where licensed data is stored, transformed, replicated, extracted, cached, archived, or backed up.

• Assess current database security capabilities and identify gaps, constraints, risks, and prerequisites.

Data-Level Authentication and Identity Integration

• Assess authentication for named users, service identities, workloads, and analytical tools accessing databases.

• Evaluate OAuth/OIDC or other identity- and token-based authentication directly to the database where supported by the selected technology.

• Design integration between enterprise identities, security groups, project groups, database principals, roles, and policy engines.

• Reduce reliance on shared or long-lived credentials where feasible and define secure credential or token handling for unavoidable exceptions.

• Align with tools currently available and identify gaps if any

Fine-Grained Authorization and Data Firewalling

• Design database-level controls that restrict access to explicitly authorized users, groups, services, projects, or licensing populations.

• Design and implement row-level security, column-level security, dynamic masking, views, policy-based filtering, or equivalent controls as appropriate.

• Define isolation patterns for different licensed datasets and agreements while preserving permitted platform use for other users.

• Ensure controls are consistently enforced as close to the data layer as technically feasible and are not solely dependent on application logic.

Auditing, Monitoring, and Traceability

• Design database auditing to capture who accessed data, what was accessed, when access occurred, and which identity or service was used.

• Define logging for queries, exports, failed access attempts, permission changes, and privileged activity where supported and required.

• Integrate audit telemetry with appropriate monitoring and reporting capabilities and define retention and evidence requirements.

• Validate that audit records are searchable, attributable, protected from inappropriate modification, and useful for investigation.

Data Lifecycle, Revocation, and Deletion

• Design controls for access revocation when users change roles, leave a project, or when licensing rights expire.

• Design methods to identify and remove licensed data from primary stores and relevant downstream copies, extracts, caches, or derived stores.

• Address deletion implications for referential integrity, backups, archives, replication, recovery processes, and downstream consumers.

• Define validation, exception handling, and evidence mechanisms to demonstrate that required deletion activities were completed.

Solution Architecture and Engineering

• Translate requirements into current-state and target-state architectures, technical specifications, security patterns, and implementation plans.

• Compare solution options and document trade-offs across security, feasibility, performance, scalability, operability, cost, and technology constraints.

• Define database connectivity, policy-enforcement, identity, audit, monitoring, lifecycle, and integration components.

• Collaborate with database, IAM, security architecture, infrastructure, application, data platform, governance, and scientific teams.

title: Software Engineer, Guardian
description:
About the Team

The Guardian team builds practical safety and oversight systems for increasingly capable AI agents. Our goal is to make it possible for agents to take on longer-running, higher-autonomy work while preserving meaningful safeguards, respecting user intent, and intervening when actions could cause serious or difficult-to-reverse harm.

Auto-review is an early example of this work. When an agent reaches a permission boundary, a separate model evaluates the proposed action in context and determines whether it should proceed. The team is now extending this foundation into more capable oversight systems that account for richer user context, support a broader range of agent experiences, and integrate across OpenAI products.

Guardian sits at the intersection of engineering, alignment research, product, infrastructure, and security. The team already has a strong engineering foundation in London and will continue to grow there as a concentrated, highly collaborative group.

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Guardian team in London. You will design and build production systems that evaluate agent behavior, identify risk, and take appropriate action without creating unnecessary friction for users.

This is a hands-on engineering role with substantial technical depth and ownership. You will work across architecture, implementation, evaluation, and operations, taking projects from early exploration through production deployment. The work requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound product judgment, and comfort solving problems where both the requirements and the underlying technology are evolving.

You will work closely with alignment researchers to translate emerging research into dependable systems, and with product and engineering teams to make agent safety a foundational capability across OpenAI.

This role is based in our London office.

In this role, you will:

- Design, build, and operate core components of Auto-review and the broader Guardian platform, balancing safety, product utility, latency, and operational reliability.

- Build production systems that evaluate agent actions in real time, detect potentially harmful behavior, and support safe recovery or escalation paths.

- Improve how oversight systems understand user intent, environmental context, permissions, and relevant personalization signals while protecting privacy and avoiding unnecessary friction.

- Partner closely with alignment researchers to turn prototypes, evaluations, and new monitoring techniques into scalable product capabilities.

- Work across Product, Security, Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to integrate Guardian capabilities into agent experiences throughout OpenAI.

- Develop evaluations, adversarial tests, and monitoring to understand safety performance, false positives, latency, and user impact.

- Own projects end to end, contribute to technical direction and design reviews, and investigate failures to improve system behavior and reliability.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have experience building and shipping complex production software, with ownership across design, implementation, deployment, and operation.

- Have built with AI agents or large language models in a core product, startup, or technically serious independent project, and understand the unique challenges of agentic systems.

- Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and can design reliable backend services, APIs, and infrastructure.

- Exercise sound product-engineering judgment and can navigate tradeoffs across safety, usability, speed, and reliability.

- Enjoy working closely with researchers, translating open-ended ideas into practical systems, and using experiments and evaluations to guide decisions.

- Are comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative, and communicate clearly across technical disciplines.

- Care deeply about building AI systems that are useful, trustworthy, and safe.

About OpenAI

Pawlicy Advisor is a profitable venture-backed startup building the infrastructure that connects pet owners to the right financial protection for their pets, starting with the most trusted pet insurance marketplace in the US, distributed through thousands of veterinary practices nationwide. We help pet owners make better financial decisions for their pets. The company has delivered over 1 million unique quotes, has raised $19M+, has found product-market fit, and is now scaling.
Pawlicy Advisor is now hiring for an Onboarding Specialist, Vet Success.
Every week, new clinics sign up to partner with Pawlicy. Your job is to turn those signups into active partners who recommend us to pet parents. You'll own new partners from their first day, you're the voice they hear first, the person who gets them set up, and the one who makes sure the partnership takes off.
This is a phone-first, high-volume call role: you will make >40 calls a day. You will own and build relationships throughout onboarding. The role requires organization and follow-through as much as warmth and personality.
What you'll do

• Conduct 200+ phone conversations every week

• Run live onboarding calls with every new partner within its first 30 days.

• Respond to veterinary teams with follow-up emails and calls same day

• Maintain daily, up-to-date records in the internal CRM system

• Travel to veterinary conferences several times a year to work our booth, meet clinic teams in person, and kick off onboarding for the clinics that sign up.

• Get partners activated: accounts set up, teams trained, materials in use, and customers engaging.

• Introduce our integrated partner program to eligible partners, and guide the interested ones through setup and go-live.

• Keep clean records in Custify and Pipedrive so the team always knows where each account stands.

• Stay with accounts that need extra support. Hand off accounts off to a strong start to our Customer Success team.

• Spot patterns in what new partners struggle with and bring them back to the team so we can fix them.

What success looks like in your first six months

• Every new partner in your book gets a live call by day 30.

• Your cohorts hit our activation benchmarks by day 90.

• Eligible partners in your book are moving onto the integrated program.

Requirements

• 2+ years in a role where you handled 40+ calls a day: customer onboarding, recruiting, customer success, customer support, SDR, BDR, inside sales or a vet hospital CSR running callbacks. You enjoy being on the phone most of every day, and see direct communication as a way to get things done.

• Comfortable building relationships on the phone and capable of building rapport in the first minute with a busy counterparty.

• Organization at volume. You can juggle hundreds of accounts at different stages without anything slipping.

• Comfort with a light, helpful upsell. You recommend the next step because it's good for the customer.

• Comfort working in client management tools, whether that's a CRM, a customer success platform or a practice management system.

• Able to travel to 10-15 conferences a year, typically 2 to 4 days each. You're comfortable meeting people face to face at a busy booth.

• You work well remotely and set your own rhythm.

• Legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

• Must be based in the USA.

Nice to have

• Onboarding or implementation experience with customers, clients or patients.

• Experience upselling or recommending products or services.

• Veterinary clinic experience, preference C

title: Benefits Specialist

This position supports the day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs, leave requests, and workplace accommodations while partnering closely with teammates, practice leadership, HR Partners, Payroll, benefit carriers, and third-party administrators.

Compliance and Administrative support

• Identify and escalate complex cases, compliance concerns, and opportunities to improve administrative processes, communications, and workflows.

Required

Bravas creates state-of-the-art smart home technology solutions that include everything from lighting, shades, and A/V to networking, security systems, power management, and more.

The Role
The Home Experience Designer is responsible for taking input from the sales staff, completing
an original design and proposal, and turning it into a functional system to install. The Designer provides
all documentation used for building the system. While the Lighting & Shade Control Designer should
understand and support all products lines sold by the company, their main role is to serve as the subject
matter expert for lighting & shade control.

Responsibilities:

• Research product and make recommendations to the sales staff based on functionality.

• Produce documents to assist techs with installation including but not limited to plans, drawings, and elevations.

• Partner with Design and Sales team to ensure vision is achieved and all necessary aspects of functionality are included.

• Ensure requirements from other trades are specified on drawings, and communicated to PM.

• Create new and innovative ways to obtain desired results while adhering to budget and product constraints.

• Attend weekly design meetings with the other engineers to obtain feedback on designimprovements.

• Review sales order, product lists and elevations with sales staff, PMs, and programmers as needed.

• Update project documentation, proposals, and change orders in job management software.

• Recommend products to bench test and demo before specifying into actual proposals.

• Contact vendor and industry experts regarding any new equipment or engineering issues.

• Provide remote support for other techs in the field.

• Occasionally travel to sites to witness systems in use.

• Provide training or communication to disseminate pertinent information to other techs in the field.

• Fiscal responsibility for all assets assigned and property within Designer’s care.

• Customer service, including ability to work with high profile and high demand customers.

• Guardianship and preservation of client confidentiality and network/home security.

• Adherence to state and federal laws, including adherence to traffic laws.

Qualifications:
The Home Experience Designer must possess an understanding of all AV systems while having a
distinct proficiency with lighting and shade control. They must also be able to read and construct
documentation such as house plans, elevations, and lighting diagrams, etc. Must pursue continuing
education on all systems with focused curriculum CE on lighting and shading control.

• Lighting fixture specification and load calculation

Software (Preferred):
• D-Tools SI

Experience working with lighting control platforms such as:

• Lutron

• Crestron

• Control4

• Savant

• Technical aptitude and attention to detail are paramount

• Position is remote work eligible

• Flexibility to meet customer demands outside of normal working hours

description:
Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days.

Salary: £30,000-£40,000

SC Clearance Requirements:

Due to working with several government bodies, SC clearance is required for all our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. In future, DV clearance may be required, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

You must be UK-based.

About us

We help major public and private sector organisations scale cloud and AI with speed, control and clarity. Hard-won experience sits behind a values-led business that does the right thing, puts customers first and builds partnerships on trust rather than lock-in.

Our work is practical. We design secure, production-ready foundations that hold up in the real world and deliver lasting value, without the waste that slows most transformations down. And we don't advise from the sidelines. We build, fix and deliver ourselves, with no offshoring, no resource-padding and no compromises.

What you'll do

Cloudscaler works closely with three of the companies shaping cloud and AI right now: AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI. Those partnerships open real doors for us and our customers. Funding for customer programmes. Early access to new models and services. Joint go-to-market. But they only pay off when someone runs them properly. That's this role.

You'll own the operational side of our partner programmes. Your goals are clear: help us win partner funding for our customers, achieve new AWS competencies and programme designations, and keep our partner CRMs in excellent shape. The partner managers at AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI will know you by name.

This isn't a back-office admin job. AI partner programmes change quarter to quarter, and we want someone who'll build smarter ways of running them. If you've ever automated a tedious task because you couldn't face doing it by hand a second time, you'll fit right in.

External responsibilities

These responsibilities are partner-facing and customer-facing:

Competencies and programme designations - Driving our AWS competency and programme applications, and tracking tier requirements, certifications and renewals across AWS, Anthropic and OpenAI so that nothing lapses.

Partner funding applications - Preparing, submitting and tracking partner funding applications (for example the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) and proof-of-concept funding), working with our sales and delivery teams to gather what each one needs.

Funding claims - Managing funding claims through to payment, keeping milestones, evidence and deadlines in order.

Partner relationships - Acting as the main operational contact for our partner teams, building strong working relationships with each company.

Joint campaigns and events - Helping plan and run joint marketing campaigns with our partners, and representing Cloudscaler at partner events across the UK.

Internal responsibilities

These responsibilities cover the systems, reporting and ways of working behind our partner programmes.

Partner CRMs - Owning our partner CRMs, keeping deal registrations, opportunity data and partner portals accurate across HubSpot and AWS Partner Central.

Reporting - Reporting on partner performance, funding pipeline and programme health to the leadership team.

Automation - Finding the repetitive work and automating it, using AI tools such as Claude to build workflows, trackers and agents that give the team time back.

Briefing colleagues - Briefing colleagues when programmes change, and explaining what it means for our customers and bids.

title: Lead Designer
description:
Lead Designer 

- Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

- Team: UX 

- Salary: €63,000 - €75,000

- Contract: Permanent

- Reporting To: Head of UX

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in France. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

- Own UX strategy for our EU programme end to end, with real judgement over what to prioritise and how, as the market and the team's shape itself still takes form

- Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data on the ground locally, including wider teams and client-side engineers,bringing user needs into decisions from the start, not added on afterward

- Use our established research methods to bring real insight into your own design work, and feed what you learn locally back into the wider team's shared understanding

- Lead and grow two designers based in London, building one genuinely connected team across EU and the UK from early on

- Shape how local work becomes part of our shared platform and design system, so what you build here compounds for every client after, not just this one

- Build directly in code where useful, using AI-assisted tools to prototype or ship small front-end changes yourself, closing the gap between design and delivery

- Go beyond representing UX, be an active voice in the trade-offs between PMs and Design, holding the right balance between client-specific needs and our global approach, including directly with clients and stakeholders in workshops, showcases, and pre-sales conversations across the EU market

- Help define what design leadership looks like across a genuinely distributed function, UK, EU, and Australia, while it's still being built

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

- A track record owning UX strategy and delivery end to end for a complex, multi-stakeholder product, ideally in a regulated or operationally complex industry

- Experience designing in B2B or B2B2C environments, for professional, repeat users rather than casual consumers

- Direct experience managing or mentoring other designers, comfortable leading a small team while still doing hands-on design work yourself

- Experience working from, and contributing back to, a shared platform or design system, not just consuming one

- Comfort working close to code, confident using AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to go from design to a working interface yourself

- A genuine appetite for building something from an early stage, comfortable with ambiguity that comes with shaping a team and a market presence, not just operating inside one already settled

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

- Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

- Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

- Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

- Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

- Go furthe

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

- Project & Delivery Focus - Proven ability to manage complex projects independently, translate regulatory prose into technical finance requirements, and meet tight deadlines with precision.

- Cross-functional Ownership - Strong accountability for assigned reporting streams and seamless collaboration across Product, Data, and Tech teams.

title: GTM Recruiter, Singapore

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. - A strong record of GTM hiring in Singapore and APAC across BDR, sales, solutions consulting, and field leadership

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Machine Learning & Data Infrastructure
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a seasoned engineer to build and improve the ML and data infrastructure behind our risk and fraud prevention systems. You will work hands-on to move models from experimentation into reliable production services, improve model execution performance, and develop data pipelines that support training, evaluation, and real-time decisions. You will take ownership of your work, identify improvements proactively, and deliver with limited guidance

What You’ll Be Doing

• Improve model inference latency, throughput, resource utilization, and cost. Profile the prediction path-from feature retrieval and preprocessing to model execution-and implement measurable improvements while preserving model quality.

• Build and maintain infrastructure for model packaging, versioning, deployment, serving, monitoring, and  rollback across cloud platforms and regions.

• Develop and optimize offline data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark , and warehouse or lakehouse technologies. Address data modeling, partitioning, joins, shuffles, skew, incremental processing, and cost.

• Work on offline and online feature pipelines, supporting point-in-time correctness, consistent feature definitions, freshness, lineage, and reproducible backfills.

• Build and maintain reliable feature services and data integrations for risk models and decision systems.

• Take ownership of projects and operational issues, communicate progress and tradeoffs, and collaborate with ML, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and product teams.

• Contribute to technical discussions, share knowledge, and help teammates through code reviews and collaboration.

 

What We Look For In You

• Experience building and operating distributed systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms, with ownership of meaningful production components.

• Hands-on experience improving production model performance, such as latency, throughput, resource utilization, or cost.

• Strong experience with Databricks and Spark, or comparable offline data platforms, including execution plans, distributed query optimization, storage layouts, data correctness, and workload cost management.

• Experience with the model lifecycle, including training and serving integration, validation, deployment, observability, and rollback.

• Strong Python and  SQL skills, plus proficiency in at least one backend or systems language such as Java, Scala, Go, or C++.

• Ability to work independently through loosely defined problems, make sound implementation decisions, and deliver maintainable systems with limited guidance.

 

Nice to Haves

SageMaker, Alibaba Cloud PAI/EAS, or comparable ML platforms.

•
Inference optimization using tools such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or Triton.

•
Delta Lake, MLflow, feature stores, Kafka, Flink, and low-latency data stores.

•
Fraud detection or financial risk systems.

•
Fluency in Mandarin

Competitive total compensation package

L&D programs for employees' growth and development

•
Various team building programs and company events

•
Wellness and meal allowances

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

More that we love to tell you along the process!

The Fire Sprinkler Fabrication & Coordination Engineer is responsible for preparing detailed shop drawings and fabrication plans for fire sprinkler systems. This role requires close coordination with other trades, including HVAC and structural teams, to ensure seamless integration of fire protection systems into overall project designs. Experience working with 3D scans is considered an advantage.

• Develop accurate shop drawings and fabrication plans for fire sprinkler systems.

• Coordinate with HVAC, structural, and other trade teams to resolve design conflicts and ensure project alignment.

• Utilize AutoSPRINK software to design and detail fire sprinkler layouts.

• Apply Autodesk ReCap for 3D scanning and integration when applicable.

• Review project specifications and ensure compliance with industry standards and codes.

• Provide technical support during fabrication and installation phases.

• Maintain documentation and records of design changes, coordination meetings, and fabrication schedules.

Qualifications
Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, or related field (preferred).

• Minimum 2-3 years of experience in fire sprinkler design, fabrication, or coordination.

• Experience with 3D scanning technology is a plus.

Technical Skills

• Proficiency in AutoSPRINK (mandatory).

• Familiarity with Autodesk ReCap (preferred).

• Strong knowledge of fire protection systems, fabrication processes, and industry standards.

• Ability to interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.

Core Competencies

• Excellent coordination and communication skills across multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
